title: Bundled desktop restores native histories after an offline process restart
description: Living D06 desktop proof for ri_b1bb5ad00e17. Use an isolated copied desktop app with production assets, private userData and an owned watched gateway. The supervisor selects FARMSLOT_NATIVE_STORE_DESKTOP_CONTROL, FARMSLOT_NATIVE_STORE_PROOF, FARMSLOT_UI_URL and the desktop CDP port. The helper uses actual desktop settings/login, host-backed closed-history setup, the native view and OPFS SQLite. During the owned gateway outage its supervisor waits for the operator to confirm the private app normal Quit dialog, verifies a successful exit, and restarts that exact private app, retaining its profile and origin. A new process must restore 200-message histories, ten saved sessions and their original age, disable visible Resume, and recover without replay. This is setup-time history, not provider-execution evidence. Evidence remains outside source.

proofTargets.claim: The actual native host supplies complete history to the real conversation view.
Opened histories retain the last 200 complete messages.
The browser SQLite store retains ten opened histories.
A new offline document restores the opened conversation.
Cold restoration preserves the exact saved time and visible age.
The actual Resume action is disabled while saved data is stale.
Current reads restore history and Resume authority after gateway restart.
Clicking the stale action neither sends nor replays a command.
A different desktop process restores the same saved history while the gateway is stopped.
